export type Movie = {
  id: string;
  /** External TMDB reference. Present on TMDB-sourced movies only. */
  tmdbId?: number;
  title: string;
  poster: string;
  backdrop: string;
  description: string;
  genre: string[];
  language: string[];
  duration: number; // minutes
  rating: number;
  certification: string;
  releaseDate: string; // ISO
  cast: string[];
  director: string;
  trailer: string;
  status: "now-showing" | "coming-soon";
  popularity: number;
  formats: Format[];
};

export type Format = "2D" | "3D" | "IMAX" | "4DX";

export type Theatre = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  city: string;
  address: string;
  rating: number;
  distanceKm: number;
  screens: { id: string; name: string; seats: number }[];
  formats: Format[];
};
